note: Social Auth Facebook is a Social Auth network implementation for Facebook OAuth2 login. Its real login flow needs an external Facebook/Meta app, so all cases here are grounded in LOCAL config only. Config object social_auth_facebook.settings (keys: client_id [App ID], client_secret [App secret], graph_version [without leading v, e.g. 17.0], scopes, endpoints) has NO config/install, so it is absent until saved; baseline = object deleted. Settings form route social_auth_facebook.settings_form -> /admin/config/social-api/social-auth/facebook, permission 'administer social api authentication' (from social_auth). Adds /user/login/facebook (+ /callback). Network plugin id social_auth_facebook (short_name facebook), auth manager FacebookAuthManager. Rules events social_auth_facebook.user_login/user_created exist when rules is enabled. Medium cases write a distinctive value into social_auth_facebook.settings and read it back; hard cases build local config (graph_version, client_id) verified against live config. reset/cleanup delete the config object to restore baseline.

evals.prompt: Which Drupal config object stores the Facebook credentials for the social_auth_facebook module, and which two keys hold the Facebook App ID and App secret?
evals.expected_output: Credentials live in the social_auth_facebook.settings config object; the App ID is stored in client_id and the App secret in client_secret (other keys: graph_version, scopes, endpoints).

evals.prompt: After enabling social_auth_facebook, what login URL does it add for users to authenticate with Facebook, and what is the OAuth callback/redirect URL you must register in the Facebook app?
evals.expected_output: It adds the login route /user/login/facebook and the OAuth callback /user/login/facebook/callback (the latter is the Valid OAuth Redirect URI to register in the Meta app).

evals.prompt: At what admin path is the Social Auth Facebook settings form, and which permission is required to access it?
evals.expected_output: The settings form is at /admin/config/social-api/social-auth/facebook (route social_auth_facebook.settings_form), protected by the 'administer social api authentication' permission provided by Social Auth.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the Social Auth Facebook configuration and state which Facebook Graph API version is currently configured.
evals.expected_output: social_auth_facebook.settings graph_version is 18.0. Read via `drush cget social_auth_facebook.settings graph_version`.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the Social Auth Facebook configuration and give the Facebook App ID (client_id) that is currently set.
evals.expected_output: social_auth_facebook.settings client_id is fb_probe_appid_9988. Read via `drush cget social_auth_facebook.settings client_id`.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the Social Auth Facebook module to use Facebook Graph API version 17.0. Apply the change to the live site's configuration.
evals.expected_output: Set social_auth_facebook.settings graph_version to '17.0' (stored without a leading 'v'), e.g. `drush cset social_auth_facebook.settings graph_version 17.0 -y` or via the settings form. Verified: graph_version === '17.0'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, set the Social Auth Facebook module's Facebook App ID (client_id) to 'fb_app_probe_123456'. Apply the change to the live site's configuration.
evals.expected_output: Set social_auth_facebook.settings client_id to 'fb_app_probe_123456', e.g. `drush cset social_auth_facebook.settings client_id fb_app_probe_123456 -y` or via the settings form's App ID field. Verified: client_id === 'fb_app_probe_123456'.
